job.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description_html:
Forward Deployed Engineers at Tessellate AI work inside our customers’ teams to put our LLM platform into production.

  • Embed with a customer for weeks at a time and own the technical outcome
  • Write production Python and TypeScript: integrations, data pipelines, evals
  • Feed what you learn back to product and engineering

You have shipped software with customers, not just demoed it.
